intro: Paris Saint-Germain beat Aston Villa in the UEFA Super Cup, with goals from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Desire Doue, BBC Sport reports. The result hands Paris Saint-Germain another piece of silverware in a fixture that traditionally pits European club competition winners against each other, and it gives both clubs a high-profile early-season marker.

sections.heading: Context: the teams and the competition
sections.text:
The UEFA Super Cup is a one-off match organised by UEFA which traditionally features the winners of the Champions League and the Europa League from the previous season. It has long been seen as a curtain-raiser for the European competitive calendar, offering a chance for continental success before domestic leagues get fully underway.

Paris Saint-Germain are one of France’s most prominent clubs with a high-profile squad and a recent history of domestic dominance. Aston Villa are an established English club with a storied past in the English football pyramid. For both clubs, appearances in a match of this stature are opportunities to demonstrate squad depth and to add a trophy to the cabinet ahead of the domestic campaign. BBC Sport’s coverage highlights the decisive PSG scorers in this fixture.
